props.text: Controls exercise packed live replacement, append, clear, line width, grid updates, and the native plot toolbar.

Toolbar buttons: Fit refits data, Pan drags the view, Zoom uses the mouse wheel, Box drag-zooms a selected area, Grid toggles grid lines, Axes toggles axes and ticks. The plot supports solid, dashed, dotted, and dash-dot series with an in-plot legend.
PASS: controls update this plot without rebuilding the widget tree.
PASS: static multi-series renders both traces.
PASS: y-only data uses sample index for x.

dirty.note: DragonGUI applies coarse dirty flags immediately; this history records the recent command reasons that triggered them.
